gaps.statement: Incompatible processing-speed denominators prevent direct comparison.
Physical bounds need a compositional system-level account.
Logical throughput must include fault-tolerance overhead.
Task-specific quantum advantage must not be generalized into universal speed.
Thermal extraction and irreversible operations need explicit performance linkage.

rejected_gap_candidates.statement: Atoms alone create one immutable upper speed for all computers.
rejected_gap_candidates.reason: Not supported by the evidence plan.
Contradicted by quantum-speed-limit and fault-tolerance evidence.
